verdict.rationale: The evidence shows that Dropbox has a desktop client page and keeps files synced across devices. A first-party page about saving hard drive space on your devices loosely implies online-only (on-demand) files. However, nothing explicitly documents the specific power-user features the story asks for. Missing for 10: explicit macOS and Windows client documentation, a selective sync feature, an explicitly named online-only/on-demand files feature, and independent or hands-on corroboration of sync reliability.
